decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a versatile, standard-sized backpack for daily use. While the feed contains many high-rated items, the majority are specialized products such as sling bags (NICGID, MOSISO), hydration packs (Lunidry), or niche equipment bags for sports like disc golf and baseball. I evaluated the Explorer Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_171) as it is the closest to a general-purpose bag, but customer reviews raised concerns about long-term durability, specifically regarding the bottom wearing out and zipper reliability. Given the current options are either too specialized or have questionable build quality for heavy use, I have decided not to make a purchase during this session.
